title: The 'swear the oath yourself' warning at the Wardmoor oath-stone ('whoever swears it stands in it from then on') read as an irreversible/dangerous commitment but turned out to be just a rank-flavor status change; a clearer warning of actual mechanical stakes (or lack thereof) would help players decide without fear of a hidden softlock.
